resources.string: Google text recognition needs its model, which Google Play services downloads once. It runs on this phone: nothing you scan is sent anywhere. You can switch back to the open engine in the Privacy Center.

Turns on the conveniences that lean on your phone\'s platform: Google text recognition, opening lab-results links, the nearby-spot banner, follow-up check-ins, and the online map. Screen protection stays on. Some lines hold in every mode: no phone backups of your journal, no cloud model reading it, no analytics, and no Terpoir server.
